title: OAS Trailmap — Application Requirements Register
description: A maintained source-code requirements inventory for OAS Trailmap the web application. Not the OAS award requirement checklist. Statuses represent code inspection, not certification of browser end-to-end testing.

status_definitions.implemented: A corresponding implementation is identifiable in the repository; end-to-end verification is not implied.
status_definitions.partial: Some pieces exist but the agreed experience is incomplete or not fully evidenced.
status_definitions.planned: Agreed direction, not implemented as a complete workflow.
status_definitions.future: Exploratory brainstorm only; not an approved requirement.
